title: Checks for usage of std::mem::forget(t) where t is Drop or has a field that implements Drop.
summary: std::mem::forget(t) prevents t from running its destructor, possibly causing leaks. It is not possible to detect all means of creating leaks, but it may be desirable to prohibit the simple ones. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for mem::replace() on an Option with None.
summary: Option already has the method take() for taking its current value (Some(..) or None) and replacing it with None. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for mem::replace() on an Option with Some(…).
summary: Option already has the method replace() for taking its current value (Some(…) or None) and replacing it with Some(…). Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for std::mem::replace on a value of type T with T::default().
summary: std::mem module already has the method take to take the current value and replace it with the default value of that type. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for mem::replace(&mut _, mem::uninitialized()) and mem::replace(&mut _, mem::zeroed()).
summary: This will lead to undefined behavior even if the value is overwritten later, because the uninitialized value may be observed in the case of a panic. Clippy puts this lint in the correctness group, at the level deny.
